verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents its own AI Receptionist that answers and routes calls, and its Agentic Voice AI platform automates customer interactions, which covers answering the line and implies routing to humans. Message-taking is not evidenced, and handoff is only implied by 'route'. missing for 10: documented AI message-taking, explicit human handoff/escalation behavior, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human

citations.quote: AI Receptionist Answer and route calls on any phone system.
reliable and scalable Agentic Voice AI platform to automate, assist, and analyze customer interactions end-to-end.
